description: Source file implementing CUDA profiling stubs for PyTorch, including CUDA event management, error checking, and NVTX integration.

classes.name: CUDAMethods
classes.description: Implements CUDA profiling methods such as recording events, measuring elapsed time, marking regions, and device synchronization.

classes.name: RegisterCUDAMethods
classes.description: Registers the CUDAMethods instance for use in the profiler.

methods.name: cudaCheck
methods.description: Checks the result of a CUDA call and throws an error with detailed message if it fails.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a CUDA event on the current stream, optionally associating it with a device and capturing CPU timestamp.

methods.name: elapsed
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two CUDA events in microseconds.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Marks a region in the CUDA profiler timeline, or warns if not available.

methods.name: rangePush
methods.description: Pushes a profiling range, or warns if not available.

methods.name: rangePop
methods.description: Pops a profiling range, or warns if not available.

methods.name: onEachDevice
methods.description: Executes a function on each CUDA device.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Returns whether CUDA profiling is enabled.
